name: Wall Hop Battles
desc:
⚔️ Welcome to Wall Hop Battles!⚔️ 

Challenge your friends to a Wall Hop competition! Starting with three lives, you take turns wallhopping different obbys. The wall hops become more difficult over time, and they timer slowly ticks down. Thanks so much for playing!

📊 Your stats will be automatically saved for next time!

📅 Join the group for update notifications! https://www.roblox.com/communities/35632691/Babus-Studios#!/about 📅

🔵 Current Stages - 25

If you don't know how to wallhop, don't worry! Look up a video online and you will find many simple video tutorials! Give it a go yourself!

Liking👍and favoriting the game helps me out so much!
